name: Catan
description: Trade resources, build settlements, and compete to become the dominant force on the island of Catan.

name: Ticket to Ride
description: Collect train cards and build railway routes across the map to connect cities and complete destination tickets.

name: Carcassonne
description: Build a medieval landscape by placing tiles and strategically claiming cities, roads, monasteries, and fields.

name: 7 Wonders
description: Develop an ancient civilization through card drafting, scientific discoveries, military strength, and architectural achievements.

name: Azul
description: Collect colourful tiles and arrange them into beautiful patterns while carefully planning your moves.

name: Kingdomino
description: Build your own kingdom by connecting landscape dominoes and selecting valuable territories.

name: Pandemic
description: Work together as a team of specialists to contain global outbreaks and discover cures before time runs out.

name: Dixit
description: Use imaginative storytelling and beautifully illustrated cards to inspire clues and guess other players' choices.

name: Codenames
description: Give clever one-word clues to help your team identify secret agents while avoiding dangerous selections. Cooperative play is available through Codenames Duet.

name: Just One
description: Work together to help one player guess a mystery word using creative one-word clues.

name: Sushi Go!
description: Pass cards around the table and collect delicious sushi combinations to score the most points.

name: UNO
description: Match colours and numbers, play action cards, and race to empty your hand before everyone else.

name: The Crew: The Quest for Planet Nine
description: Complete challenging missions together through trick-taking gameplay and limited communication.

name: Forbidden Island
description: Explore a sinking island, collect hidden treasures, and escape together before the island disappears.

name: Hanabi
description: Work together to create a spectacular fireworks display by sharing clues about cards your teammates cannot see.
